title: Advocates have no right to demand out of turn listing of their cases: Madras High Court
description: The Madras High Court recently said that advocates have no right to demand out of turn listing of their cases except through established procedures in urgent matters [Charles Alexander Vs Registrar General]A Bench of Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G Arul Murugan made the observation while dismissing a petition filed by advocate LK Charles Alexander, who had sought a direction to the High Court Registry to list 21 pending cases filed by him on behalf of his clients."An ind
